It takes twenty minutes to get to the repair shop by bike. David learned a lot about history. The weather was windy that day. Do not jaywalk with the kids.
Life is full of small surprises. David is going to travel to Chengdu in May. David wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, the scientists stored the radioactive materials in thick lead boxes.
David likes windy days best. The repair shop is one of the best places in the city. David thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. There are dark clouds in the sky.
David and Leo had great fun there. David wants to be a engineer in the future. Leo is interested in singing.
